tool_args.rationale: The Hill-2 substrate response with competitive sink inhibition and linear bleed is the best-supported stationary law. The five observations provide a minimally overdetermined numerical fit of its four parameters; the observed sink-gradient range is ample, and no slow-horizon ambiguity is indicated.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The Hill-family note calls for this only when the s_grad span is under 0.08; the observed span is 2.00, so it is not needed to resolve that stated ambiguity.
No trajectory/memory signature or changing horizon supports paying for an ODE batch; the rows are all at the forecast horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: barrier-modulated siphon or other smooth families
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: They are alternatives, but the supplied sigmoidal-onset and sink-gradient signatures, plus the task's transformed-Hill context, directly motivate the four-parameter Hill-2 inhibition model.
